name: Break-Even Calculator
description: Calculate break-even sales volume in units and revenue, contribution margin per unit, margin ratio, and margin of safety.
search_intent: Calculate break-even point in units and dollars for business, products, or services.

inputs.label: Variable cost per unit (materials, labor, shipping)

calculation: Contribution margin per unit = salePricePerUnit − variableCostPerUnit. Contribution margin ratio = (contributionMargin / salePricePerUnit) × 100. If contribution margin <= 0, break-even is unattainable and returned as null. Break-even units = ceil(fixedCosts / contributionMargin). Break-even revenue = breakEvenUnits × salePricePerUnit. Projected revenue = plannedUnitSales × salePricePerUnit. Total costs at target = fixedCosts + (plannedUnitSales × variableCostPerUnit). Projected net profit = projectedRevenue − totalCosts. Margin of safety percentage = plannedUnitSales > 0 ? ((plannedUnitSales − breakEvenUnits) / plannedUnitSales) × 100 : 0.
limitations: Assumes constant unit selling prices and constant variable unit costs across all production volumes.
Semivariable step costs (e.g. hiring an additional supervisor once volume exceeds a threshold) are not modeled.
Does not factor corporate taxes, interest expense, or inventory carrying depreciation.
